title: CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan Rate Card: Pickup, Lab Shipping and Loaner Instruments
content:
How instruments travel between the customer and Corbett's lab, and what a loaner instrument costs while the customer's own instrument is at the lab, depends on the tier of the CalCare Tool Repair & Calibration Plan.

| Tier | Route-truck pickup and return at no charge | Fee per pickup when not included (USD) | Prepaid lab shipping label provided | Loaner fee per week (USD) | Longest loaner period (weeks) |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| CalCare Pay-Per-Service | no | 45.00 | no | 75.00 | 2 |
| CalCare Basic Plan | no | 45.00 | yes | 75.00 | 2 |
| CalCare Standard Plan | yes | 0.00 | yes | 60.00 | 3 |
| CalCare Accredited Plan | yes | 0.00 | yes | 40.00 | 4 |
| CalCare Onsite Plan | yes | 0.00 | yes | 20.00 | 6 |
| CalCare Enterprise Plan | yes | 0.00 | yes | 0.00 | 8 |

**Column meanings**

- Route-truck pickup and return: whether Corbett picks up and returns instruments by route truck at no charge.
- Fee per pickup: fee per pickup when not included, USD.
- Prepaid lab shipping label: whether a prepaid lab shipping label is provided.
- Loaner fee per week: fee per week for a loaner instrument while the customer's instrument is at the lab, USD.
- Longest loaner period: longest loaner period in weeks.

**Quick reads**

- Pickup and return by route truck is included from CalCare Standard Plan upward; on CalCare Pay-Per-Service and CalCare Basic Plan a pickup is priced at 45.00.
- CalCare Pay-Per-Service is the only tier without a prepaid lab shipping label.
- The weekly loaner fee falls from 75.00 on the first two tiers to 0.00 on CalCare Enterprise Plan, while the longest loaner period grows from 2 weeks to 8 weeks.
